title: Chapter 2719: Entering the Level 4 Black Zone
content:
Chapter 2719: Entering the Level 4 Black Zone

"They all died...?" Yu Rou muttered with a dazed expression.

"How did they die?" she proceeded to ask.

Yuan shook his head.

"I don’t know."

"If you’re really from the future, you’re essentially telling me that there’s no hope—that we’ll all die from the invasion," Yu Rou said a moment later.

"Well..." Yuan paused for a moment before responding, "Things will be different this time because I’m here."

Despite his words, Yuan’s voice lacked its usual confidence. Even he wasn’t certain whether he possessed enough strength to repel the invasion.

’I have ten trillion years’ worth of Eternal Essence... I should be able to deal with anything that isn’t the Void Hunter or Eternals now...’

As this thought crossed his mind, the world suddenly trembled again—far more violently than ever before.

Yu Rou’s expression changed drastically, and she immediately summoned a screen displaying the scene outside.

"T-This is...!" Yu Rou clenched her jaw and fists tightly as she watched cracks spread across the sky like a massive fissure.

The barrier appeared to be reaching its breaking point, as though it could shatter at any moment.

However, just as everyone’s stomachs sank in despair, the cracks suddenly began to mend on their own. Within moments, the damage completely vanished, and the barrier returned to normal.

"We’re running out of time..." Yu Rou sighed.

She turned to look at Yuan and said, "You need to defeat the Void Hunter before the invasion begins."

Yuan raised an eyebrow. "Huh? Why all of a sudden? Defeating the Void Hunter should be the least of our worries right now."

"Although we can fight from within our own cities, that isn’t ideal. We need to coordinate with the other cities, and the only way we can gather safely is if you defeat the Void Hunter first," she explained the reasoning behind her request.

"..."

Yuan fell silent, as he currently lacked the capabilities to defeat the Void Hunter.

"What’s wrong?" Yu Rou asked, noticing his stiff expression.

Yuan sighed, then admitted, "I can’t beat it. Not right now."

"I’m not asking you to defeat it immediately, but it’d be great if you could do it by the end of the year—if the barrier can even last that long."

Yuan shook his head and elaborated, "It’s not a matter of time. I just can’t defeat it... period."

Yu Rou frowned and said, "You were able to make the Void Hunter retreat during your last encounter with it."

"I don’t know why it suddenly left, but it’s definitely not because it thinks I could defeat it. It also left during our first encounter, and I couldn’t even fight it properly back then."

He looked down at his own hands and continued, "I have reached a bottleneck during my last training session, and unless I evolve my physique, I won’t be able to get stronger."

"Evolve your physique? It’s already at the peak!" Yu Rou said with a frown.

"The peak?" Yuan chuckled. "In the world of cultivation, there is no such thing as a true peak. You can always climb higher."

He turned around and started walking away.

"Where are you going?"

"To fight the Void Hunter."

"What?" Yu Rou’s face immediately looked confused.

"You literally just claimed that you can’t defeat it no matter how much time you’re given seconds ago!"

"That’s right. I can’t improve my raw strength any further, but there are other ways to boost one’s strength."

"That doesn’t explain why you’re going to fight the Void Hunter right now."

"How else am I going to train? Although the Endless Assault is a decent place to go, it cannot compare to fighting the real Void Hunter."

"Are you going to bash your head at the Void Hunter until you die or somehow manage to defeat it? That’s too reckless! If you die before the invasion even—"

"Don’t worry, the Void Hunter won’t kill me. If it really wanted to, I wouldn’t be here right now. It wants something from me, and I am going to bother it until I figure out what. Of course, I don’t expect to defeat it, but who knows? A miracle might happen."

"Oh, I don’t need any soldiers to come with me. The Void Hunter will probably appear even if I am alone when I approach the Level 4 Black Zone."

"..."

Yu Rou was left speechless, and she silently watched as Yuan left her world.

After leaving, Yuan wasted no time, leaving the city and heading straight to the Level 4 Black Zone.

He’d considered doing the level 7 treatment first, but he didn’t have enough time, as that would surely put him in a coma for several months, and there was a good chance it wouldn’t benefit him anyways.

However, just to make sure, Yuan initiated the level 7 treatment to see what sort of warnings he’d get.

<Utilizing Level 7 Treatment>

<Warning! Warning! Warning!>

[Warning: Level 7 treatment may cause intense pain for the user due to the nature of the anomaly]

[Warning: Level 7 treatment may affect the user’s memories due to the nature of the anomaly]

[Warning: There is a small chance the user may die from the treatment.]

Yuan stopped in his tracks upon seeing the new warning, which directly stated that there was a chance he could die from the treatment.

"I could die? How would that work?" he mumbled with a puzzled face.

After all, he could recover even from a destroyed soul—something that would kill anyone else.

"Forget it... I can worry about it later... when I actually plan on doing it..."

Yuan shook his head and continued toward the Level 4 Black Zone.

Eventually, Yuan arrived at the border of the Level 4 Black Zone.

He waited for several hours, but when the Void Hunter still failed to appear, Yuan finally shouted into the distance, "Come out! I know you can sense me! I don’t know what you want from me, nor do I care, but I am going to beat you this time!"

Yet, the Void Hunter still did not appear.

"..."

After contemplating for a long moment, Yuan decided to enter the Level 4 Black Zone.
